name: Feature 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A feature field distillation technique based on the 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that enables rendering of arbitrary-dimensional semantic features by learning a semantic feature at each 3D Gaussian, in addition to color information, guided by 2D foundation models.
summary: Feature 3D Gaussian Splatting renders arbitrary-dimensional semantic features using an explicit point-based representation with parallel rasterization, achieving faster distillation than NeRF-based methods.
